definition: A vector representation summarizing the semantic content of an entire document or document chunk, used for similarity-based retrieval.
details: Document embeddings allow systems to compare and search across large collections of text efficiently by reducing each document to a fixed-size vector that captures its meaning.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is Document Embedding.
